text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
All right! Let's do our best, everyone!
Aiming for a big victory, here we gooo~!

text_block_list.name: Biko & Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeahhh!
Yeahhh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Currently at Tracen Academy, a basketball tournament
with 8 participating teams was taking place.

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text:
A round-robin league―which means
there are 7 games in total. It will be a long haul, but
let us do our best in the first match!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! Leave it to me!
You've got Windy-chan on your side!
Our goal is an undefeated sweep! Nothing less, nodaa~!

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Guh... Complete defeat.
To think we would lose by triple digits...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Mrmmm... Too bad! It's so tricky,
the ball just bounces all over the place!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
But everyone gave it their all until the final buzzer!
Not giving up until the very end, that's super admirable!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
The tournament has only just begun!
Let's get fired up for the next match too~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...However, in the next match as well―

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Darn it...! Sorry, everyone!
If only my special move had landed...!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
No way, Biko-chan, you put up a great fight!
You win the 'Gave It Everything on a Long Shot' award!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Next time for sure, let's join forces and win!
Ready, set, gooo!

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text: Guh...! Time is running out...!

text_block_list.name: Referee
text_block_list.text:
Game over! Great effort from both teams.
Please do your best in the second half tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Another loss...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: This is totally boring, noda~~!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
8th place the whole time!
Dead last the whole time!!
We're not standing out at aaaaall, noda~~!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
But but, your passing got way better, Windy-chan!
Thanks to you, we were able to take so many shots!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
None of that matters if we can't win, noda!
...Hmph, whatever!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
―The next day,
on the day of the tournament's second half...

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Windy-san, please wait!
Let us have one more strategy meeting.
So that we may claim victory next time!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
*Hmph*. I can't hear a thiiing, noda.
Windy-chan is way too busy planning
her next prank, noda.

Umm, tuck in the elbows,
and visualize a solid axis through the core―

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, this feeling is really important!
I gotta make sure not to forget it during the game.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph, what a zealous one, noda.
Practicing right up until the game starts.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Windy-chan!
Ehehe, of course―

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
After all, Big and the others are in top form!
Let's keep this momentum going full steam ahead~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Huuuuh~~~!?
In what world, noda!? We've been
losing non-stop from the very start, haven't we~!?

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's true!
Big and the others are stuck in 8th place, dead last―

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
But that means we're the 8th strongest
team in all of Tracen Academy, right!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Things might not have gone smoothly
for Big and the team, but―

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text: Because we took on the challenge, we made it to 8th place!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
If we hadn't challenged ourselves, we wouldn't even have a ranking!
Compared to that,
aren't we super duper big right now!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
So you see, both Big and everyone on the team!
We're so awesome that we deserve tons and tons of praise!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ! Awesome... Windy-chan is...?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are~! Ehehe, sorry to keep you waiting~♪
Let's win for sure today, Big-san!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Windy-senpai and the others are here too!
Then there's only one thing to do! A strategy meeting!

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Windy-san.
What do you say?
Would you care to challenge it one more time?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
............Hmph! Windy-chan was planning
on doing that from the very beginning, noda!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Running away is totally uncool,
and unbecoming of the Great Demon King!
Let's go, you guys!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Visiting to spectate the basketball tournament
held at Tracen Academy―

text_block_list.name: Referee
text_block_list.text: Game over! An incredible effort from both teams!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girls
text_block_list.text: "We... did iiit~~~!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Something like this is only natural, noda!
...Well, I suppose I could acknowledge
everyone else's hard work too, though!

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, it is all thanks to not giving up until the very end.
...We owe you our gratitude, Big-san!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
No no, it wasn't just Big!
Every single person here worked hard,
so eveeeeryone gets 1st place!
